outcomes.mechanism: The direct end reason is still the host planning safety cap (a planning tick exceeded 30 wall s), not a final stance decision; the batched-rect fix removed the earlier 30 s exhaustion path but a remaining expensive planning path still exceeds the cap at 6.4 SIM s. The stance ledger shows a feasible-ish cyan_1 clearance: 14.94 mm, while the observed fresh margin was 18.75 mm. At the measurement floor the margin is 11.07 mm, so a close fresh observation (within about 0.81 m) could clear this stance. The safe fix is to find/batch the remaining expensive planning path first, not to change the cap or the margin constant.
outcomes.round3_candidate: identify the remaining 30 wall-s planning tick (sampled/full-pose or wall-layer path) and batch it like search23_batched_rects_v1; then re-check the cyan_1 stance with a close fresh observation

wall-layer activation in the adapter's _plan_approach aborts the just-started obstacle reobserve on the same tick

outcomes.mechanism: The nominal stance is clear by 46.7 mm, but the red_1 memory margin (46.3-52.1 mm) exceeds it whenever red_1 is not freshly measured. The goal set alternates between a feasible stance (fresh measurement) and all-blocked (memory inflation) and never progresses. The stale-cargo reobserve that would refresh it is aborted at elapsed 0.0 by wall-layer activation, and the earlier retreat-first reobserve never reaches its view attempts because it finishes at the retreat boundary. The fresh-measurement floor margin (11.07 mm) is far below the 46.7 mm gap, so this world is rescuable by perception/ordering fixes, not by changing the margin constant.
outcomes.round3_candidate: do not abort a just-started obstacle reobserve when the wall layer activates (or only abort wall-target reobserves); let retreat_first proceed to the camera/body views after the retreat; keep red_1 to >=5 visible probes through the approach motion

outcomes.mechanism: Under the nominal sampled +/-15-degree stance set the best cyan_1 clearance is 4.87 mm, below even the measurement-floor margin of 11.07 mm (5 mm + 3.03*sigma with sigma>=2 mm). This stance set is therefore structurally blocked by the runtime margin, not by a fixable reobserve: the admission filter accepted this assigned end with 12 certified poses at only >=5 mm clearance. The 91-pose certified family may contain poses with larger clearance, but the runtime goal set did not evaluate/settle on them.
outcomes.round3_candidate: do not try to fix this with a controller tweak; either evaluate the full certified family under the runtime margin (sampled-stance coverage) or escalate the admission/runtime-margin mismatch for a start-set decision. This world is the expected remaining failure if only 6, 15 and 27 are fixed.

structural_finding.admission: warp_flow_admission.certify (setup only) accepts an assigned end if free_goal_N>0 certified poses have body clearance >= FRESH_MARGIN_M (5 mm); it records min_gap_m, not the full clearance distribution.
structural_finding.runtime: the teacher rejects a pose when gap < FRESH_MARGIN_M + K*sigma, where sigma includes the 2 px/2 mm observation floor and propagated command covariance; the floor margin is 0.01107 m.
structural_finding.mismatch: 3 of the 40 immutable starts (worlds 15, 27, 37) were admitted with at least one certified pose at min_gap_m 0.0, below the runtime floor margin. Worlds 15 and 27 have rescuable stances (14.94 mm and 46.7 mm clearances, respectively); world 37's sampled best is 4.87 mm and is not rescuable without a closer look that changes the estimate or a different certified pose.
structural_finding.decision_needed: whether to keep the immutable 40 starts (accept world 37 as the expected remaining failure and require the other 39 to pass 38+) or re-admit starts with a margin-aware criterion / evaluate the full certified family. Re-admission would change the pre-registered start set and must not be pooled with the r1/r2 starts.

gate_arithmetic.needed_for_min_38: fix any two of {6, 15, 27, 37}; 6, 15 and 27 are the plausible fixes, 37 is structurally blocked under the current sampled set
gate_arithmetic.best_case: 39/40 with only world 37 failing; any regression in a previously passing world would drop below 38
